_about: The 2020-2024 research rows of the run-up study (pdufa_runup_bifrost_v2.csv rows dated before 2025, which have no decision pages), each checked on 2026-11-20 against a source for the FDA action. in_study true: the source states that approval or Complete Response Letter for that drug, made public on the row date or up to 3 days before it (a CRL a company disclosed days after the letter is dated to the disclosure, the market's first look). Sources: the FDA's Drugs@FDA approval record (as listed in the Orange Book, with its Drugs@FDA link), the FDA's published CRL letters (openFDA CRL dataset), an fda.gov page, the sponsor's or co-developer's own release or SEC filing, or, for a few rows with no such source found, a dated trade report. in_study false: the reason the row is not a PDUFA approval or CRL for that ticker on that date: a trial readout or other event the old pipeline read as an FDA action because its text said 'approval' or 'complete response'; an advisory committee vote, emergency use authorization or tentative approval; a generic (ANDA) or device action, which has no PDUFA goal date; a date that matches neither the action nor its first public announcement; a company that was not a party to the product then (the ticker counts only as sponsor or its parent, US co-developer or co-commercializer, or US royalty or milestone holder at the time); or a second row for one action. runup_study_events.eligibility() keeps a research row only with an in_study entry; curate_runup_study.py moves the rest to runup_study_excluded.csv with the reason.
